summary: A Yes vote establishes a 1-cent general sales tax in Sutter County, shared by the County and the Cities of Yuba City and Live Oak, lasting until ended by voters and raising about $22,500,000 annually for services including water supply, fire and emergency response, sheriff's and police patrols, and road repair.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves a 1% general sales tax and adds its revenue to the county general fund.
tax.quote: Measure G, a 1% general sales tax that needs only a majority, and deposits the money in the general fund.

safety.text: A Yes vote provides flexible general-fund revenue that may be used for sheriff services but is not dedicated to policing or prevention.
safety.quote: General-fund revenue is more flexible for a county facing sheriff, road, and state-cuts pressures.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the 1% general sales tax and does not add its revenue to the county general fund.
tax.quote: Measure G, a 1% general sales tax that needs only a majority, and deposits the money in the general fund.

safety.text: A No vote does not provide the additional general-fund revenue authorized by the measure.
safety.quote: General-fund revenue is more flexible for a county facing sheriff, road, and state-cuts pressures.
